# SQLite amalgamation

This directory vendors the official SQLite 3.50.4 amalgamation for Android,
where the NDK does not provide a public SQLite development library.

- Source: `https://www.sqlite.org/2025/sqlite-amalgamation-3500400.zip`
- `sqlite3.c` SHA-256: `e3f5d6901e7492af4a1fc8c4d745cae84c264942524c3fbfc02b82a5ca8818c8`
- `sqlite3.h` SHA-256: `abd1514e0351f79393d1be882830afdb40a8099e8257f311f0bfdf8486f11bea`

SQLite is in the public domain. See `https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html`.
